## Checklist
- [ ] `pytest` passes locally
- [ ] `ruff check reconowl tests` is clean
- [ ] New/changed behaviour is covered by tests
- [ ] For a new check: it confirms findings (low false positives), attaches
      request/response proof, is registered in `engine.py`, and has a CVSS vector
- [ ] Docs/CHANGELOG updated if user-facing
